== visible: drop and get
> Ann: drop note
Ann: You drop the <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> drops their <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>...
> Ann: get note
Ann: You pick up the <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> picks up the <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi>...
== visible: put into a container
> Ann: put note chest
Ann: You place your <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi> into the <ansi fg="container">chest</ansi>
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> places their <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi> into the <ansi fg="container">chest</ansi>
== visible: give to Bob
> Ann: give note Bob
Ann: You give the <ansi fg="item">note</ansi> to <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> gives you their <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>.
== visible: give to the rat
> Ann: give note rat
Ann: You give the <ansi fg="item">note</ansi> to <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> gave their <ansi fg="item">note</ansi> to <ansi fg="mobname">rat</ansi>.
Input rat: "emote considers the <ansi fg=\"itemname\">note</ansi> for a moment."
== visible: equip and remove
> Ann: equip shirt
Ann: You wear your <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi>. ( <ansi fg="204">-19 health</ansi> )
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> puts on their <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi>.
> Ann: remove shirt
Ann: You remove your <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi> and return it to your backpack.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> removes their <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi> and stores it away.
== visible: read
> Ann: read note
Ann: You look at <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>...
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> looks at their <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>...
Ann: The scribbling on the note has been worn away and can no longer be read.
== visible: unlock and lock a door exit
> Ann: unlock east
Ann: You use a key to unlock the <ansi fg="exit">east</ansi> lock.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> uses a key to unlock the <ansi fg="exit">east</ansi> lock
> Ann: lock east
Ann: You use a key to relock the <ansi fg="exit">east</ansi> lock.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> uses a key to relock the <ansi fg="exit">east</ansi> lock
== visible: show to Bob
> Ann: show stick Bob
Ann: You show the <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi> to <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> shows you their <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi>.
Bob|
Bob| It looks kinda sticky.
Bob| - It looks like a 1-Handed weapon.
Bob|
== visible: drop all and get all
> Ann: drop all
Ann: You drop <ansi fg="gold">20 gold</ansi> on the floor.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> drops <ansi fg="gold">20 gold</ansi>.
Ann: You drop the <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> drops their <ansi fg="item">sharp stick</ansi>...
Ann: You drop the <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> drops their <ansi fg="item">note</ansi>...
Ann: You drop the <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> drops their <ansi fg="item">cotton shirt</ansi>...
> Ann: get all
Ann: You pick up <ansi fg="gold">20 gold</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> picks up some <ansi fg="gold">gold</ansi>.
Ann: You pick up the <ansi fg="itemname">sharp stick</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> picks up the <ansi fg="itemname">sharp stick</ansi>...
Ann: You pick up the <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> picks up the <ansi fg="itemname">note</ansi>...
Ann: You pick up the <ansi fg="itemname">cotton shirt</ansi>.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> picks up the <ansi fg="itemname">cotton shirt</ansi>...
